local_review.finding_body: FS-test-contract.2.2 and FS-contribution-contract.4.6 (visibility bypass): DefaultDgsDataLoaderProviderTest.kt carried @file:Suppress("INVISIBLE_REFERENCE", "INVISIBLE_MEMBER") so that it could call DefaultDgsDataLoaderProvider.findDataLoaders(). In graphql-dgs 10.5.0 that method is Kotlin `internal` (annotated @PostConstruct), so no consumer can call it directly. The covered dynamic-access call sites (addDataLoaderComponents/addDataLoaderFields reflection) were therefore reached through access nobody ships. Evidence: sources jar DefaultDgsDataLoaderProvider.kt line 106-107 `@PostConstruct internal fun findDataLoaders()`.
local_review.finding_title: Test bypasses Kotlin internal visibility with @file:Suppress(INVISIBLE_MEMBER) to call a library-internal method
local_review.fix_note: In DefaultDgsDataLoaderProviderTest.kt I removed the @file:Suppress and register DefaultDgsDataLoaderProvider as a Spring-managed bean (context.registerBean with a Supplier), so Spring runs its @PostConstruct discovery as a real consumer does, then call the public buildRegistry(); the same assertions remain. Spring only honours @PostConstruct when jakarta.annotation-api is on the classpath, and graphql-dgs does not declare it (Spring Boot normally supplies it), so I added testImplementation 'jakarta.annotation:jakarta.annotation-api:3.0.0' to the test project's build.gradle. That is a genuinely needed missing dependency. The stored test-only metadata did not cover the new Spring annotation-processing path, so I regenerated it from the tests with generateMetadata and finalization rewrote src/test/resources/META-INF/native-image/reachability-metadata.json (harness-generated, not hand-written); the library metadata ended unchanged. Dynamic-access stats stay 11/11. Nothing outside the contribution's files was touched.
local_review.review_comment: Checked the single-library, single-version diff against skills/review-library-new-request and FS-contribution-contract sections 2 to 4. Shape: only the target coordinate's metadata, index.json, stats and tests/src files; only reachability-metadata.json files; the test-only metadata under src/test/resources/META-INF/native-image is harness-generated, as in the other test projects. Tests: real library behaviour through DgsSchemaProvider, GraphQL execution, DefaultDgsDataLoaderProvider and DefaultInputObjectMapper; none is scaffold-only, there are no native-image skips and no Error catches, no version pinning (build.gradle uses the TCK-resolved version), no direct test-side reflection, no native build/run flags, and the Kotlin toolchain is wired to testJvmVersion. Tests live in com_netflix_graphql_dgs.graphql_dgs, separate from the library package. One file per dynamic-access class and no '$' in names. Coverage: dynamic access 11/11 (100%), above the 20% gate; PR-reported entries 80 library + 130 test-only = 210 against 11 covered calls, so no entry-count mismatch. Library metadata contains no test-package types. Index validation passed in the local gate record. One violation was found and repaired in place (see fix_note); after the repair the Forge finalization command (all three test lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validity, library statistics) exited 0 with no further publishable change.
